notes: Frozen original geometry with additive sample-index metadata at the observation boundary, plus identical current observation and firing-state rules in both variants; no manual shots. Sequential fresh processes, order alternated by trial. Summary median/p95 are medians of the corresponding per-process statistic; maximum is the largest observed step across all trials. Init times use different loading pipelines and are not compared as summary-build cost. State JSON compared byte-for-byte, including observer records, team contacts and query/cache counts. CPU steps, not FPS. The fixture issues no fire commands, so projectile and impact generation are not exercised by this observation benchmark. Fixture is shared with the ordinary benchmark.
